title: BodyPosture
description: Schema for a BodyPosture compendium entry (Rpg/Compendium/Posture.cs).

Expr.description: An expression: either a DSL string (leading '=', e.g. "= 1 + target.constitution"; see Rpg/Scripting/DOCS.md) or a literal (number, string, boolean, null, or an array of those).

BodyPosture.description: Body posture definition for posture-based movement and combat modifiers.

name.description: Human-readable name of the posture (e.g. stand, crouch, prone).

maxStability.description: Number expression (Target=Body, $0=Movement Intensity). Maximum stability for this posture.

stabilityRecovery.description: Number expression. Rate of stability recovery per second for this posture.

idealHeight.description: Number expression. Relative ideal interactable height [0,1].

heightTolerance.description: Number expression. Allowed deviation from ideal height in meters.

defensiveness.description: Per-part-tag exposure modifier while in this posture.

movement.description: Number expression (Target=Body, $1=Movement Intensity). Movement speed multiplier.

onTick.description: Effect expression. Executed each tick while in this posture.

canStayInPosture.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Checked every 10 ticks for posture maintenance.

canEnterPosture.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Checked when attempting to enter this posture.
